trans-unit.source: Each row needs to represent one set containing the features and the label. Seperate items with a comma (spaces before and after the comma are okay). trans-unit.source: The Pima Indians Diabetes data set involves predicting the onset of diabetes within 5 years in Pima Indians given medical details. It is a binary (2-class) classification problem. The number of observations for each class is not balanced. There are 768 observations with 8 input variables and 1 output variable. Missing values are believed to be encoded with zero values.
trans-unit.target: Is-sett tad-dejta dwar id-dijabete tal-Indjani Pima jintuża biex ibassar jekk id-dijabete tiżviluppax fi żmien 5 snin, abbażi ta’ informazzjoni medika. Din hija problema ta’ klassifikazzjoni binarja (2 klassijiet). L-għadd ta’ osservazzjonijiet f’kull klassi mhuwiex ibbilanċjat. Is-sett fih 768 osservazzjoni, 8 varjabbli tal-input u varjabbli tal-output waħda. Huwa maħsub li l-valuri nieqsa huma kodifikati bħala żero.
